doc: The ONE movement and feel tuning file (owner 11-08), read by scripts/core/locomotion.gd (Loco) for the farm avatar and every match hunter alike. Live: with the movement readout open (F7, or Settings > Controls), saving this file re-reads it within poll_s. Units: m, s, m/s, m/s^2; drags are 1/s (the share of the excess lost per second, exponential). air: accel = how hard WASD pushes in the air; counter = multiplier on accel for the part of your speed going against the keys (a backward drift turns forward in ~0.1 s); side = multiplier for the part going across the keys (bends the arc); drag = how fast speed above your run cap (dash, knock, launch) bleeds in the air; idle_drag = what a jump with no keys loses per second. glide (the pull toward where you steer is [game data], HunterMove.glide_accel): turn / turn_fast = deg/s at cruise and the share kept at the max; brake / brake_deg = pulling back past this angle brakes this hard; drag = how fast speed above cruise bleeds with no keys (back to cruise in ~1.5 s), drag_steer = the same while steering; coast = m/s^2 a let-go under cruise slows; catch = m/s^2 the canopy eases a fall to its sink rate (absorbed, never turned into speed; ours: the source clamps the fall the step the glider opens, HunterMove.glide_start_vy, and its fastest-fall half is locked); max = the fastest a glide carries. glide_carry: per hunter, speed above this carried from Shift into a glide bleeds at carry_drag (on top of drag), so a dash never turns into a long sprint. dash.jump_keep: the share of a ground dash's speed a jump out of it keeps (the rest is air drag's, Loco.air_step; 1 = all of it, a long dash-jump). dash_speed: per hunter, a dash's speed scale (its time stretches so the distance stays); the shape of a dash (ease in, peak, skid) is the hunter's source curve in content/rules/dash_feel.json. hunter, dash and physics (moved here from the Hunter consts and hunter_move.json, feel-tuning-consts; no number changed): every key has a note in its section's notes, tagged by where it comes from: [D] game data, [F] footage, [O] owner call. hunter: jump_v m/s a jump leaves the ground with, gravity m/s^2 (up and down), glide_speed m/s a glider's cruise, glide_sink m/s its steady fall, ledge_air_accel m/s^2 steering on a ledge rise. dash: speed, time, regen (s per charge) of the base dash, ex_cd s of the long dash, buffer s a Shift pressed early waits, ex_time_mul and ex_dist (m) the long dash's time (x the base time) and reach when the class sets none (the farm's, and a match hunter's time). physics: HunterMove's ground stop, dash exit, fall, glide, dive and mantle tunables for every hunter (read once at start, not live); hunter_move.json keeps the per-hunter speed and accel rows. feel: the rest of the hunter movement consts (moved from hunter.gd and DropFeel, feel-one-tuning-home; no number changed), read once at start by HunterFeel: ledge and abyss lifts, mantle and wall reach, glide heat and feather windows, the opening drop and its landing, the ledge rise and fling; its notes give each key's unit and a tag: [E] estimate to tune by eye, besides [D] [F] [O] above.

notes.jump_v: [D] JumpZVelocity 7.5 m/s; ours 6.8 so jump + mantle tops out under four of our 0.8 m terraces [O]
notes.gravity: [D] DefaultGravityZ -1470 uu/s^2, the same up and down
notes.glide_speed: [D] MaxGlide 500 uu/s; item 163 'too fast and controllable' [O]
notes.glide_sink: [F] one steady sink whatever the speed; 1.4 is floatier than the source read of 2-4 m/s [O]
notes.ledge_air_accel: [O] a ledge rise steers crisply (a jump steers by air.accel)

notes.jump_keep: [O] the share of a ground dash's speed a jump out of it keeps
notes.speed: [O] the base dash 19 m/s x 0.19 s = 3.6 m (23 felt too fast)
notes.regen: [O] seconds to win back one dash charge
notes.ex_cd: [F] the long dash's cooldown: in the air, or with the short one on cooldown
notes.buffer: [O] a Shift pressed this long early fires as the move ends
notes.ex_time_mul: [O] the long dash lasts this many base dash times when the class sets no ex_time
notes.ex_dist: [O] the farm's long dash reach in m when the class sets no ex_dist (a match hunter's is speed x time)

notes.brake: [D] BrakingDecelerationWalking 2220 uu/s^2, m/s^2: the constant part of the walking stop
notes.ground_friction: [D] GroundFriction 1.0 x BrakingFrictionFactor 2, 1/s: the share of speed a let-go sheds per second (a run stops in ~0.17 s, ~0.3 m)
notes.dash_exit_run: [O] a dash ends at this share of run speed (never faster than the dash); the data has no hard stop and the exit curves are not decoded
notes.abyss_fall_cap: [D] the fall cap over the abyss, reached at abyss_slow_to
notes.abyss_slow_from: [D] AbyssFallSlowDistMin, m under an island lip where the fall starts easing
notes.abyss_slow_to: [D] AbyssFallSlowDistMax, m under the lip where the fall reaches abyss_fall_cap
notes.glide_height: [D] GlideDownwardForceHeightTarget, m: above it the glider pulls you down
notes.glide_pull_vy: [D] GlideDownwardForceMinZVelocity, m/s: the pull's fall speed (never turned into speed, owner 11-08)
notes.glide_accel: [D] GlideTargetXYForce 162500 over Mass 100, m/s^2: the glider's pull toward where you steer
notes.glide_start_vy: [D] GlideStartFallSpeedMin, m/s: the slowest fall the step the glider opens (the matching Max is locked, see glide.catch)
notes.turn_rate: [D] RotationRate yaw, deg/s: the body turns to the cursor at a fixed rate
notes.mantle_vy_cap: [D] MantleSuctionUpwardsForceZSpeedCap, m/s: the suction pulls only while you rise slower than this
notes.mantle_pull: [D] MantleSuctionUpwardsForceMax over Mass 100, m/s^2 (the distance curve that scales it is not decoded: the max is used throughout)
notes.mantle_launch_keep: [D] MiniMantleXYSpeedTargetCoefficient: the share of run speed onto a ledge you climb
notes.mantle_launch_min: [D] MiniMantleXYSpeedTargetMin, m/s: at least this onto a ledge
notes.dive_vy: [D] GlideDiveZTargetSpeed, m/s: the plunge speed while crouch is held under the glider
notes.dive_accel: [D] GlideDiveZForceMax over Mass, m/s^2: how fast the plunge speeds up
notes.dive_steer: [D] GlideDiveXYForceMultiplier: the share of the glide's steering the keys keep in the plunge
notes.dive_cancel_h: [D] GlideDiveCancelDistance, m above the ground where the plunge ends and the glide catches you
notes.dive_timeout: [D] GlideDiveTimeout, s of holding before the plunge ends on its own

notes.spirit_climb: [E] m/s a Spirit Walk rises up a ledge face (Phase Walk goes through raised terrain)
notes.jump_buffer: [E] s: a jump pressed this long before you land goes off as you land
notes.air_decel: [E] m/s^2: let go on a ledge rise and you mostly stop
notes.air_overspeed: [E] m/s^2: on a ledge rise, momentum above run speed (a dash, a pad) still carries and bleeds at this rate
notes.glide_grav: [O] m/s^2, gravity while a glider is open and the heat is gone
notes.glide_engage: [E] scripted input only (checks, demos): hold glide this long in the air and it opens. A player's keys never hold-open it (glide_press_only) (the dedicated glide button, Mouse 5, opens it at once)
notes.abyss_lift: [E] upward pull (m/s^2) just under the lip
notes.abyss_lift_per_m: [E] m/s^2 per m of depth: plus this per metre deeper (10m down: 92 m/s^2)
notes.abyss_lift_max: [E] m/s: fastest climb just under the lip
notes.abyss_lift_max_per_m: [E] m/s per m of depth: plus this per metre deeper (12m down: ~18 m/s; item 63: ~30% under the old ~25)
notes.abyss_lift_cap: [O] m/s: item 63: the deepest climb is 30% softer than the old 26
notes.abyss_brake_dist: [E] m: that brakes near ground level (let go just before to keep the height)
notes.abyss_brake: [E] m/s^2, the brake that slows the lift in its last abyss_brake_dist
notes.abyss_lip_vy: [E] m/s still rising as the lift reaches the lip: it bounces up past it
notes.abyss_brake_gain: [O] m/s per m: (movefeel) rise speed per metre left in the brake zone (was 2: the last metre crawled)
notes.mantle_reach: [D] m: MantleSuctionUpwardsForceHeightMax: a lip this far above you pulls you up
notes.tall_climb_extra: [D] m: Archer and Juggernaut also climb double-high ledges ([game data] bCanWallJump)
notes.mantle_reach_abyss: [E] m: below an island's lip over the abyss, its side catches you this far down (movefeel: was 3.5) (a bit past the normal ledge reach); deeper you slide down the face
notes.wall_catch_reach: [O] m: (movefeel) over the abyss below a lip, a wall this far from your side catches you (elsewhere 0.4)
notes.abyss_glide_room: [E] m: a glider with heat left (lifting you out) gets this much more room
notes.ledge_reach: [E] m, a ledge this far above you can be climbed (walk into it)
notes.ledge_cd: [E] s, before another ledge climb may start
notes.float_speed: [E] m/s, the fastest a float (a lift's hang at the top) carries you sideways
notes.glide_fall: [O] m/s, the glider's sink with fuel (the readout's number)
notes.glide_time: [O] s: (owner: "lasts too long, not punishing enough") was 14s of level glide before the heat ring turns hot
notes.dive_speed: [E] m/s, top flat speed in the dive
notes.drop_fall: [E] m/s, the open glider's sink in the opening drop
notes.drop_speed: [E] m/s, top flat speed under the open glider
notes.dive_vy_rate: [E] 1/s: the dive reaches its fall speed in ~0.3s (was 4)
notes.drop_vy_rate: [E] 1/s: the canopy settles to its sink in ~0.2s after it opens (was 4)
notes.deploy_pop: [E] m/s: the canopy catching: your fall checks to this, then settles to drop_fall
notes.deploy_h: [E] m: the glider opens by itself this high above the ground
notes.feather_keep: [E] seconds after closing the glider that its speed and steering carry
notes.feather_min: [E] s of heat: the glider reopens with this much heat room left (was 0.15)
notes.feather_tap: [E] s: an abyss lift's first this-many seconds are its quick impulse
notes.feather_tap_heat: [E] x heat rate: heating like a level glide; held past it, the full 4x
notes.lrise_speed: [F] the fastest rise from deep in the abyss (HunterMove.rise_vy)
notes.lrise_min: [E] m/s: up speed walking into a ledge starts its rise with
notes.lrise_pop: [E] m/s: up speed as you clear the lip with no jump (a ~0.25m pop)
notes.lrise_off: [E] moved this far out from the face: you've let go
notes.lrise_window: [E] m: the fling window: the last this-many metres below the top (~0.12s)
notes.fling_height: [E] m: a fling timed in the window peaks this high over the top
notes.fling_speed: [E] m/s: going this fast toward your keys (run speed is ~5)
notes.fling_early_height: [E] m: a jump before the window: only just over the top, at run speed
notes.drop_accel: [E] m/s^2, speeding up toward the keys under the glider (90% of top speed in ~0.28s)
notes.drop_dive_accel: [E] m/s^2, the same in the dive
notes.drop_brake: [E] m/s^2, slowing down or turning back (let go of the keys)
notes.drop_flare_h: [E] m, the glider flares (slows the fall) this far above the ground
notes.drop_flare_fall: [E] m/s, the fall speed it flares down to
notes.drop_flare_rate: [E] 1/s, how quickly the flare takes hold
notes.wall_kick_rise: [E] m of extra jump height a wall kick adds: one terrace (World.LEVEL)
notes.wall_hop_climb_cap: [E] m above the take-off ground a wall hop may still start (a plain jump's apex)
notes.wall_face_reach: [E] m past the body a wall you face (not touching) still answers a hop
notes.wall_face_rise: [E] m of ground above your feet that counts as a wall to hop on
notes.wall_kick_press: [E] dot: keys this far into the wall (~66 degrees) climb it
notes.wall_kick_away: [E] dot: keys this far away from the wall push off it
notes.wall_kick_keys_min: [E] stick deflection (0-1) that counts as pressing a direction for a wall kick
notes.wall_kick_push: [E] m/s away from the wall for a push-off
notes.wall_kick_slide_keep: [E] share of the speed along the wall a push-off keeps
notes.wall_kick_push_jump: [E] share of Loco.jump_v a push-off jumps with
notes.wall_bounce_keep: [E] share of the speed that survives a wall rebound
notes.wall_bounce_head_on_deg: [E] degrees: closer than this to the wall's normal it doesn't bounce
notes.wall_bounce_min_into: [E] m/s into the wall: a walking-speed jump brushing a wall doesn't ricochet
notes.wall_bounce_knock_quiet: [E] s after a knockback in which the wall slam rules apply instead of a bounce
notes.wall_bounce_steer: [E] m/s^2 your keys steer a wall rebound for wall_bounce_window
notes.wall_bounce_window: [E] s to steer a wall rebound before ordinary air control returns
notes.mantle_carry_keep: [D] share of the approach speed a mantle leaves the lip with (MiniMantleXYSpeedTargetCoefficient)
notes.mantle_approach_dot: [E] dot: keys or momentum this far into the face (cos ~63 degrees) catch a ledge
notes.mantle_push_speed: [E] m/s into the face: momentum alone is a push
notes.mantle_peak_decay: [E] m/s per s: how fast the remembered approach speed fades
notes.mantle_mini_s: [D] s a mantle's speed is held after the lip (MiniMantlePostLaunchDuration)
notes.lift_open_kick: [E] m/s of spring when the glider opens deeper than abyss_brake_dist under the lip
notes.lift_kick_heat: [E] share of a full glider's heat the spring costs
notes.lift_hang_grav: [E] share of glide_grav while the lift's float lasts: a soft hang at the top
notes.lift_hang_t: [E] s the float lasts after the last lifting step
notes.ledge_air_t: [E] s in the air after which a ledge higher than where you last stood is yours to catch
notes.abyss_extra: [D] m below World.ABYSS_DEPTH a hunter is lost: 17.5m under ground level in all (AbyssHeight)
